name: triage-picks-repo
about: An item added from Slack names no repo. The runner's triage agent gets no checkouts (phase 6b: an item with no repo is routed first), only the routing context, and here settles it from that alone: it picks jarvis-loop (by its config key; the runner reports the slug), loopd records it, the thread header and /loop show say so ("not set, triage will pick" before), and the same item is then built and reviewed by the runner on that repo.
